interpretation_rule: Natural gradient has a distinct optimization advantage only if it improves held-out likelihood or recovery/cost without reducing convergence relative to the standard Jacobian-aware trust-region baseline. Matched outcomes do not establish a uniquely information-geometric benefit because the local Fisher step equals Gauss-Newton for this likelihood.
